author: Ephrayim
releaseNotes:
1.3.4 Step 1 prominent Save aliases button plus per-room Clear aliases.
1.3.3 Step 1 aliases persist in app state (no defaultValue reset on Save).
1.3.2 Fix Step 1 alias/name edits not sticking after Save, and custom rooms not adding (button click was eaten by submitOnChange; catalog enum no longer overrides a typed name).
1.3.1 Step 2 auto-refreshes during sort and shows Done/Cancelled when finished; clear stuck in-progress lock on timeout/error.
1.3.0 Step 2 per-room Target room dropdown (defaults to suggestion, or skip when room not created); red messaging for missing rooms.
1.2.0 Propose parent's room for unmatched child devices (toggle); sort via bulk POST /room/save per room (merges existing members) with setRoom fallback.
1.1.2 Recognize LR→Living Room, DR→Dining Room (capitalized + trailing space only), breakfast→Kitchen; strengthen Powder Room aliases.
1.1.1 Always log errors/warnings to hub Logs; debug toggle adds verbose progress.
1.1.0 Friendlier, clearer app pages: status legends, grouped room lists, consistent color-coded callouts, tightened copy.
1.0.2 Add per-room Sort checkboxes on Step 2 to skip sorting into selected rooms.
1.0.1 Add per-room Create checkboxes on Step 1 so detected rooms can be skipped.
1.0.0 Initial release: detect room names in device labels, create missing rooms, sort unassigned devices with preview/exclusions/leftovers and one-level undo.
